content: In the language of Oḍḍiyāna: Buddha Dharma SaṅghāyaIn the Tibetan language: To the Buddha, the Dharma, and the Saṅgha,I constantly offer respectful homage.Since the guide, the being Padmasambhava,Has revealed these accounts of his successive births for the sake of those to be trained,He protects the wise and faithful for the sake of the fortunate.Emaho!Then, the Prince Mu-khri btsan-po,Having invited the Master to the three-tiered central spire,The Master sat upon a throne of nine-layered brocade,The Abbot sat upon a throne of five-layered brocade,And upon cushions of patterned silk in the right and left rows,The three translators, headed by Vairocana, were seated.After offering many extraordinary kinds of wealth,He prostrated many times and made this request:Emaho!O Great Bodhisattva who knows the three times,My lord father Khri srong lde'u btsan has passed into the celestial realms,And you, the lamp of the teachings, are departing for the land of the rakshasas.The people of Tibet have short lives and are filled with distractions.From now until the end of the eon,For the sake of the fortunate, condensing the essence of the sacred Dharma,And enabling one to pray to you, the Guru,Please speak a concise account of your life and liberation.When he had spoken thus, the Guru replied:"Listen well, Mu-khri btsan-po!For the sake of the future, I shall show a concise summary."Emaho!There are the eight fathers who engendered me and the eight mothers who gave me birth,The eight lands where I appeared and the eight emanated sons,The eight places where I resided and the eight gurus I attended,The eight yidams whose faces I beheld and the eight signs of ultimate accomplishment,The eight charnel grounds and the eight disciples of the Dharma lineage,The eight solitary retreats and the eight ladies who arose in my heart,The eight enlightened activities and the eight hidden treasure caches,And the eight profound teachings of practice, along with the treasure-holding Lingpa masters.Emaho!First, as for how the eight names of the Guru appeared:I establish the sentient beings of the three realms in bliss;I am Guru Padma 'byung-gnas.I am the sovereign of the teachings, the Lord of Dharma;I am Guru Padma saṃbhava.Untainted by flaws and embodying the three pitakas;I am Guru Padma rgyal-po.All bliss is perfected within my body;I am Guru Rdo-rje gro-lod.All vehicles are equalized, pervading like space;I am Guru Nyi-ma 'od-zer.Within a single body, the eight manifestations are displayed;I am Guru Śākya seng-ge.Proclaiming the sound of Dharma to all the six realms;I am Guru Seng-ge sgra-sgrog.Knowing all that can be known;I am Guru Blo-ldan mchog-sred.This is the first chapter, on the Eight Manifestations of the Guru.Emaho!Now, to show the eight fathers who begot me:The father of the consciousness of basic space and awarenessIs the Dharmakāya Samantabhadra.The father who has abandoned the two extremes of birth and deathIs the protector Amitāyus.The father of all the noble ones of the six classes of beingsIs the Buddha Amitābha.The father who is the root of the Dharma and bodhicittaIs the Sambhogakāya, the Great Compassionate One.The father who is the foundation of the teachings and the SaṅghaIs the Nirmāṇakāya, Śākyamuni.The father of the great clan and royaltyIs King Indrabodhi.The human father whom I first metIs the Dharma Minister Trinadzin.The father-like friend who gave me loving counselIs the noble friend Ser-ö Dampa.This is the second chapter, on the eight fathers who sired me.Emaho!The third section, the presentation of the eight mothers who gave birth:The mother of the Dhanakośa oceanIs the lotus stalk.The uncreated Mother of Great Bliss in generalIs the immaculate Samantabhadrī.The Mother who praises the emanation bodyIs Vajrayoginī herself.The Mother who served with firm ego-clingingIs the Queen, the goddess Öchangma.The Mother who practiced the ascetic conduct of the charnel groundsIs the glorious Vajravārāhī.The Mother who perfectly bestowed the four empowermentsIs the monk Kunga Monlam.The Mother who entrusted the scrolls of the commandIs the ḍākinī Karmendrāṇī.The Mother who established the life-pillar of the teachingsIs the noble lady Jetsun Ārya Tārā.This is the third chapter, on the eight mothers who gave birth.Emaho!The fourth, showing the eight emanated sons:The son through whom the holy Dharma was established in the land of TibetIs the Dharma King Songtsen Gampo.The son through whom the holy Dharma flourished and spreadIs the Dharma King Trisong Deutsen.The son through whom the holy Dharma was kept from decliningIs the Prince Mutri Tsenpo.The son who upheld the teachings in accordance with the DharmaIs the subject Khön Lu'i Wangpo.The son who pacified the fierceIs the Indian Acarya Nagpo.The son who restored the teachings during their fluctuationsIs the protector of the degenerate age, Jowo Rinpoche.The son who tames disciples according to their inclinationsIs Tilo Prajñāpāra.The son who upholds the teachings of the great meditatorsIs Lhajé Candragomi.This is the fourth chapter, on the eight emanated sons.Emaho!Fifth, the presentation of the eight lands to which I traveled:Born in the ocean, I traveled to the land of Uḍḍiyāna.Acting as the king's son, I traveled to the land of Zahor.Subduing the four māras, I traveled to the land of the Tīrthikas.Possessing miraculous powers, I traveled to Vaiśālī.Possessing learning and reflection, I traveled to the land of Kashmir.Performing the welfare of others, I traveled to the land of Li.Renowned and undisputed, I traveled to the land of Nepal.Through the power of aspiration, I traveled to the land of Tibet.This is the fifth chapter, on the eight lands to which I traveled.Emaho!Sixth, the presentation of the eight places where I dwelt:I dwelt in Magadha, where I established the three baskets of the scriptures.I dwelt at Vajrāsana, possessing the discipline of the Vinaya.I dwelt in the Joyful Groves, my fame spreading throughout the ten directions.I dwelt in various lands, free from partiality.Having mastered bodhicitta, I dwelt in Siṃhala.Having abandoned self-grasping, I dwelt in the Purple Willow Grove.Having magnetized the three realms, I dwelt at Yangleshö.Invited by the king, I dwelt in the central spire of Samyé.This is the sixth chapter, on the eight places where I dwelt.Emaho!Seventh, the presentation of the eight gurus I relied upon:I relied upon the great guru Śrī Siṃha,And requested the complete teachings of the Great Perfection.I relied upon the Indian Khenpo Prabhahasti,And having been ordained, I adopted the attire of a monk.I relied upon the chief of ḍākinīs, Las kyi dbang mo,And requested the complete teachings of the Eight Commands of the Peaceful and Wrathful Deities.I relied upon the noble King Pundarika,And requested the complete teachings of the Kālacakra.In the land of Kashmir, I relied upon Vimalamitra,And requested the complete teachings of the Peaceful and Wrathful Amṛta.In Siṃhala, I relied upon Mañjuśrīmitra,And requested the complete teachings of the Peaceful and Wrathful Mañjuśrī.In the land of Zahor, I relied upon Nāgārjunagarbha,And requested the complete teachings of the Peaceful and Wrathful Padma.At Nālandā, I relied upon Dhanasaṃskṛta,And requested the complete teachings of the Peaceful and Wrathful Māmo.This is the seventh chapter, on relying upon the eight gurus.Emaho!Eighth, the presentation of the visions of the yidam deities:Having opened the mandalas of the Eight Commands for Sadhana,I attained the specific great accomplishment for each command.In the eight terrifying charnel grounds,I performed the sadhana of Amṛta at Sitavana,And attained a vision of the assembly of deities of Amṛta Quality.I performed the Yangdak sadhana at Hūṃchen Rock,And attained a vision of the assembly of deities of Yangdak Mind.I performed the Yamāntaka sadhana at Jikje Tsal,And attained a vision of the assembly of deities of Mañjuśrī Body.I performed the Hayagrīva sadhana at Padma Tsek,And attained a vision of the assembly of deities of Padma Speech.I performed the Kīla sadhana at Rolpa Ling Tsal,And attained a vision of the assembly of deities of Kīla Activity.I performed the Mamo sadhana at Lhundrup Tsek,And attained a vision of the assembly of deities of Mamo Botong.I performed the Worldly Spirits sadhana at Dechen Dal,And attained a vision of the assembly of deities of Worldly Offering and Praise.I performed the Wrathful Mantra sadhana at Loka Tsek,And attained a vision of the assembly of deities of Maledictory Wrathful Mantra.This is the eighth chapter, on performing sadhana in the eight charnel grounds.Emaho!Ninth, the presentation of the eight signs of final accomplishment:When I was exiled to the borders by the King of Oḍḍiyāna,I displayed the sign of accomplishment by bringing the ḍākinīs under my control.When the King of India impaled me on the point of a stake,I displayed the sign of accomplishment by my limbs remaining unblemished.When the heretic king cast me into the river,I displayed the sign of accomplishment by not being carried away by the element of water.When the King of Zahor attempted to burn me alive,I displayed the sign of accomplishment by remaining unburned by the element of fire.While serving as the chaplain to the King at Samye,I displayed the sign of accomplishment by bringing the eight classes of spirits under my power.When I stood proud before the Sovereign King,Emanation fire scorched the King's robes;I displayed the sign of accomplishment by proclaiming, "I am great! I am mighty!"While the demonic ministers sowed discord and mocked,I displayed the sign of accomplishment by their becoming lame, rigid, and dead.When I acted as the subduer of the rākṣasas in the southwest,I displayed the sign of accomplishment by establishing the rākṣasas in the Dharma.This is the ninth chapter, on the display of the eight signs of accomplishment.Emaho!Tenth, the presentation of the eight disciples who uphold the Dharma lineage:Namkhai Nyingpo, who rides upon the rays of the sun;Sangye Yeshe, who drives his kīla into solid rock;Ngenlam Gyalchok, who intones the melody of the horse's neigh;Yeshe Tsogyal, who revives the corpses of the slain;Drogmi Palgyi, who brings the mamos into servitude;Who brings the arrogant lions and elephants under his power;Vairotsana, who is equal to the Orgyen himself;And the Sovereign King, who is able to manifest emanations.This is the tenth chapter, on the eight disciples who display emanations.Emaho!Eleventh, the presentation of the eight solitary places of prophecy:Samyé Chimpu and Lhodrak Kharchu,Drakyi Yangdzong and Yarlung Shelphuk,Drakmar Yamalung and Mönka Śrī Dzong,Sengé Dzong and Paro Taktsang Phuk.This is the eleventh chapter, on the eight solitary places.Emaho!Twelfth, the presentation of the eight ladies who captured my heart:The Indian princess Mandāravā;The gifted woman Yeshé Tsogyal;The one of perfect service, Chogroza Shélsgrön;The one of perfect faith, Margyenza Tsho;The one of perfect realization, Shéldkar Tségrön;The four royal sisters, the princesses;The one of perfect attainment, Princess Tröma Gyen;The King’s beloved, Princess Pema Sel;The Queen’s beloved, the power-bestowing Salé.This is the twelfth chapter, on the eight consorts.Emaho!Thirteenth, the presentation of the eight enlightened activities:Unattached to samsara, I engaged in various playful displays;Equal to all the Buddhas, I displayed various miraculous feats;Through the conduct of yogic discipline, I performed the practice of the corpse;Teaching the Dharma to beings, I acted as their mother and father;Having vanquished the hosts of Māra, I acted as a Buddha and Bodhisattva;Having vanquished the hosts of Māra, I acted as a Buddha and Bodhisattva;Having turned the wheel of Dharma, I set foot in the land of Tibet;Having caused the teachings to flourish, I concealed precious treasures;Having suppressed the rākṣasas, I established the world in bliss.This is the thirteenth chapter, on the eight enlightened activities.Emaho!Fourteenth, the presentation of the eight hidden treasure caches:Considering the timing, I concealed mind treasures;Upon being seen or heard, I concealed secret treasures that bring certainty;I concealed profound treasures as symbolic scripts on yellow parchment;I concealed rediscovered treasures that are wondrous and marvelous;To protect against poverty, I concealed wealth treasures;To tame various beings in myriad ways, I concealed minor treasures;I concealed two treasures that are not fixed in a single form;To protect the precious teachings, I concealed mind treasures.This is the fourteenth chapter, on the eight hidden treasure caches.Emaho!Fifteenth, the presentation of the eight dharmas to be practiced:The four collections and the four adjuncts.First, the four collections are:The Collection of the Guru Kagyé,The Collection of the Yidam Kagyé,The Collection of the Khandro Kagyé,And the Collection of the Chökyong Kagyé.Then, the four adjuncts are:There is the Great Perfection "The Sun,"There is the "Stages of the Path for Entering Secret Mantra,"There is the "Awareness Mantra of the Wrathful Guru,"And there is the "Noble Black Wrathful Mother."This is the fifteenth chapter, on the eight profound teachings of practice.Emaho!Sixteenth, the presentation of the eight Lingpas who are Lords of the Dharma:They are emanations of the eight great Bodhisattvas.In the center is Orgyen Lingpa;In the east is Dorje Lingpa;In the south is Rinchen Lingpa;In the west is Pema Lingpa;In the north is Karma Lingpa;Samten Ling and Nyida Ling,Zhikpo Ling and Terdak Ling;These eight great treasure-revealing Lingpas will appear,And they are certainly emanations of me, Orgyen.This is the sixteenth chapter, on the eight Lingpas who are Lords of the Dharma.Emaho!Great King, listen well.One such as I, Padmasambhava,Possess the five common clairvoyances,The five clairvoyances of the future,The five clairvoyances of the present,And the five immeasurable clairvoyances;These five types of clairvoyance are known to me.In former times, I was Amitābha, Boundless Light;On Mount Potala, I was the Protector Avalokiteśvara;At Dhanakośa, I was the form of Padmasambhava.Although appearing as three merely as a mode of manifestation,In reality, they are inseparable and not distinct from one another.In the realm of the Dharmadhātu, I am Samantabhadra;In the Dense Array, I am the Great Vajradhara;At the Vajra Seat, I am the Great Sage himself;Non-dual with them, I, Padma, am spontaneously present.Therefore, pray to me constantly.From the thirteen and eight generations of kings,The Emperor Sechen will lead an army into Tibet,Which will become the basis for the ruin of all Tibetan subjects;Even my temples will be destroyed.At that time, an emanation of mine named Sakya will appear,Born in the upper region as the son of a father named JampalAnd a mother named Drolma.Known as Drogon Phagpa Kunga Gyaltsen,He will restore my temples,And the teachings of the Secret Mantra will flourish and spread.The Tibetan subjects and sentient beings will experience peace and happiness.Thereafter, the kings of Tibet will engage in a scramble for power;At times there will be Dharma kings, and at times demon kings.The Dharma kings will establish the laws of religion,While the demon kings will destroy those religious laws.At that time, the people will experience all manner of prosperity and decline.In a region of Dokham, as prophesied by the Buddha,An emanation of Atiśa named Lobzang Drakpa will appear;When that noble being comes, happiness will dawn for Tibet,And at that time, the side of virtue will gain confidence.A fortress will be established at Nyimado in Me-nyang,And a temple will arise on the Red Hill in Lhasa.My emanation, Orgyen Lingpa, will appear,And at that time, he will reveal twenty-five treasure caches.When he had spoken thus, the king shed tears.Once again, prostrating and offering a mandala, he asked:"O Great Master, guide of beings,For how long will my royal lineage endure from this point on?For how long will the happiness of the Tibetan subjects and sentient beings last?"I request the Great Mahāguru to speak.Thus he entreated him, prostrating until his forehead was worn away.Then the Great Guru proclaimed:"O King, from this point onward, your royal lineageWill vanish in the upper regions like breath-mist fading from a mirror.Thereafter, the kingship of Tibet will rotate;In particular, an emanation of a bodhisattvaBearing the name of the Bhadrakalpika Sūtra will appear.This one with a mole on his face will hold the throne of Tibet,And the sun of happiness will last only as long as a shadow across a skylight.In the three years of the Horse, the Sheep, and the Monkey, the Chinese army will arrive;In the Water-Male-Monkey year, a military camp will be established in Yarlung;Ultimately, this Tibet will be brought under Chinese rule.Internal strife among paternal cousins will break out on the heights of Tagogang;From the direction of Bumthang, a corner of the throne will be suppressed.An emanation of myself will appear to uphold the kingdom and the laws of the Dharma.Conflict will arise in the fortresses of Nepal,And the sun of happiness will briefly dawn for Tibet.Having engaged in evil conduct yourself, you call it an evil age;The times do not change; it is the people who change.At that time, people will have no merit or reputation.Constantly offer prayers to me, Padma;When it is daytime, meditate on the Great Compassionate One;For the sake of sentient beings, recite the Mani essence mantra.Bearing in mind the kindness of your parents, the six classes of beings, I shall come.When night falls, meditate on me, Padmasambhava;For your own benefit, recite the Vajra Guru mantra.I shall protect all sentient beings of the degenerate age;I shall watch over them continuously throughout the three times.Even if they are born in the three lower realms, I shall come to rescue them.Although I have been very kind to Tibet, they do not recognize my kindness.If you can pray to me continuously,There is a way to avert the degenerate age of a ten-year lifespan.An emanation of Maitreya called 'Seven Cubits' will appear,And the sufferings of the evil eon of a ten-year lifespan will be liberated.Once again, the eon will increase and become joyful;Visions of the Buddha will occur again and again.Every morning and every evening, I shall come for the sake of Tibet;For those with faith, Padmasambhava sleeps at their door.For my body, there is neither death nor birth.You, known as the Prince Mutri Tsenpo,Shall work for the benefit of beings for seventeen lifetimes from now,And then depart for the land of the dakinis in Uddiyana.You, the great translator Vairocana,Hide this profound holy Dharma of mine, Padma,As a treasure in the central spire of glorious Samye;Entrust it to those with the karmic destiny in the future, he said.I will not remain, but go to subdue the rakshasas;I go to lead all the rakshasas to the Dharma;Having established the people of Tibet in happiness, I shall now depart."Having spoken thus, he turned his face to look toward the west. Samaya. Gya Gya Gya. This was retrieved as a treasure from Samyé Chimphu by the tertön Orgyen Lingpa.
